The '''Galactic Alliance Army General uniform''' was the outfit worn by [[General/Legends|Generals]] serving the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|armed forces]]. It's main color was [[Color/Legends|blue]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]], it was worn by both [[Stavin Thaal]] and [[Borath Maddeus]].
